sentence_stem: Although the project had a very tight deadline,
correct_completion: the team delivered a flawless report.
full_sentence: Although the project had a very tight deadline, the team delivered a flawless report.
acceptable_variants: the team still produced excellent work.

options.text: so the team finished it early.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, but 'although' requires a contrasting clause, so this option does not fit.

options.text: the team delivered a flawless report.
they had no time left at all.
options.why_wrong: This restates the pressure of the deadline rather than giving the contrasting outcome that 'although' requires.

options.text: the deadline was moved last week.
options.why_wrong: This adds background information but does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must present a result that contrasts with the difficulty described in the first clause. Here the difficult deadline is contrasted with a high-quality outcome.
translation: Proje çok sıkı bir teslim tarihine sahip olmasına rağmen, ekip kusursuz bir rapor teslim etti.
